nimittasaññaka: [Nimitta+saññaka]  CL=7 A thera named Nimittasaññaka, who developed Buddhānussati nimittasaññā. This thera, previously a hermit, lived near the Candabhāga River in a monastery. One day, while wandering in the forest, he saw a golden deer grazing. His mind became purified upon seeing the deer, and he developed the Buddhānussati saññā, reflecting on the Lord Buddhas—those who are enlightened, enlightening, and destined to enlighten—comparing their gracefulness to that golden deer. As a result of this meritorious deed, he avoided the lower realms for 94 eons. In one of those lifetimes, he became a universal monarch named Araññasattha in the 27th world from this Bhadda world. Later, in the present era of Gotama Buddha, he was reborn as the venerable Nimittasaññaka Thera. He attained the four aspects of paṭisambhidā, the eight attainments (samāpatti), and the six supernormal knowledges (abhiññā). He dedicated himself to spreading the teachings of Lord Buddha.

vivade: [Vi+vada+a+eyya] (kri) CL=7 will be argued and  quarrelled. Vivade(kri) [vi+vada+a+eyyuṃ]  they will be the opposite andthen argue and quarrel.
vivaṭṭūpanissayapuññakamma: [Vivaṭṭūpanissaya+puñña+kamma] (na) CL=7 wholesome deeds which is the powerful cause of attainability Nibbāna which is free from Vaṭa. (Vaṭa means The cyclic process impelled by the interaction of lust, deeds and consequences.)
yaññabhatta: [Yañña+bhatta] (na) CL=7 Sacrificial offerings of rice, Rice which should be make sacrifical offering.
yaññupāsana: [Yañña+upāsana] (na) CL=7 Taking refuge in a sacrifice, Praising the quality of sacrifice.
yogyadesāvaṭṭhāna: [Yogyadesa+avaṭṭhāna] (na) CL=7 Staying in the right place (or) Staying at the proper place.
yogātiga: [Yoga+ati+gamu+kiu] (ti) CL=7 One who overcome four Yogas. (Yoga mean shoulder yoke :lust yoke, life yoke, doctrine yoke and Ignorance yoke)
yojanikapabbata: [Yojanika+pabbata] (pu) CL=7 The mountain which has the extent of one Yojana.  (Yojana means measure of distance equal to 12.72 miles).
yojitatta: [Yojita+tta] (na) CL=7 As a matter of comparison.
yujjhāpeti: [Yudha+ya+ṇāpe+ti.yodhayati-saṃ.] (kā,kri) CL=7 (1) Let him to pierce (with tusk). (2) Let him to gore/butt (with horn/shelter). (3) Let the cocks/Two cocks (male chicken) are fighting (or) Two cocks are fighting. See also - Yujjhati.
